title: Month 1, Week 1 (Nov 8 – Nov 14, 2026): General Path (5%), Molecular I (5%) & CNS Adult Gliomas

days.b1:
Setup (30m): Initialize GitHub Repo & 4-Domain SOE Log.
Reading (60m): Robbins 10th ed. Ch. 2 & 3 High-Yield Tables — Reversible vs. Irreversible Injury (EM thresholds), Apoptosis vs. Necroptosis (RIPK1/3/MLKL) vs. Pyroptosis vs. Ferroptosis (GPX4), & Granulomatous Inflammation.
days.b2:
Spot Slides (20m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (coagulative/caseous/fibrinoid necrosis, sarcoid vs. necrotizing granuloma, reactive gliosis).
QBank (30m): 20 MCQs on Cell Death & Inflammatory Mediators.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (10m): Log 4-Domain SOE entry for Necrotizing vs. Non-Necrotizing Granulomas (GMS/ZN/Fite stains + clinical correlation).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of Cell Death pathways & Leukocyte Adhesion Deficiencies (LAD I/II/III).
Reading (75m): Robbins Ch. 4 & 6 — Tissue Repair/Fibrosis, Hemodynamics/Shock, Amyloidosis subtypes (AL, AA, ATTR, Aβ2M, ACal), & Paraneoplastic Syndromes.
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Renal/Hepatic/Cardiac Amyloidosis, organizing thrombus, keloid vs. desmoid).
QBank (25m): 15 MCQs on Amyloidosis, Hemodynamics & Paraneoplastic syndromes.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (10m): Log 4-Domain SOE entry on Amyloidosis subtyping (Congo red apple-green birefringence, laser microdissection-mass spec, EM 7.5–10 nm non-branching fibrils).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Flash-recall Amyloidosis chemical subtypes, precursor proteins, and EM fibril diameter.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 10 Timed Virtual Slides: 5 CNS basic lesions (3m/case) + 3 Thyroid FNA smears (Bethesda Cat I–III @ 6m/case) + 2 Heme reactive nodes.
QBank (45m): 25 Timed General Path MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log Bethesda Thyroid adequacy criteria (≥6 groups of ≥10 well-visualized follicular cells; exceptions: solid nodules with atypia, thyroiditis, abundant colloid) & ROM.

days.b1: Secondary System — Molecular I (90m): SCFHS Curriculum Molecular Table — FFPE block selection & tumor macrodissection (% neoplastic cellularity), nucleic acid extraction, PCR, RT-PCR, qPCR, Allele-specific PCR, Sanger vs. NGS, & STR identity/chimerism.
days.b2: QBank & EM (30m): 15 Molecular/NGS MCQs + 3 EM ultrastructural images (neuroendocrine dense-core granules, Birbeck tennis-racket granules, premelanosomes).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Review One-Pager 3 (Assay Limit of Detection: Sanger 15–20% VAF vs. NGS 2–5% VAF vs. ddPCR/Allele-specific <0.1–1% VAF).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Write out VAF sensitivity limits and clinical indications of Sanger, NGS, RT-PCR, and STR identity testing.
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 General Path + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls tagged General Path & Molecular).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect every recall distractor.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log missed 2015–2023 recall questions into your 4-Domain SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m light coffee review of Week 1 SOE Log entries.
days.b3: Click Push to sync Week 1 progress to GitHub.

days.b1: Primary System Deep Dive — Neuropathology I (2.5h): WHO CNS 5th Ed. & Rosai — Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas (Astrocytoma IDH-mutant Gr 2–4, Oligodendroglioma IDH-mutant & 1p/19q-codeleted Gr 2–3, Glioblastoma IDH-wildtype Gr 4) + CNS Intraoperative Smear vs. Frozen Section artifacts.
days.b2: Slides & QBank (90m): 12 CNS Virtual Spot Slides @ 3m/case (diffuse astrocytoma, gemistocytic astrocytoma, oligodendroglioma, GBM, gliosarcoma, reactive gliosis) + 25 CNS Glioma MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable (30m): Study One-Pager 1 (Adult Diffuse Gliomas) & record a 3-min spoken SOE response using the 4-Domain Glioma Script.
